# Web artifacts builder (Anthropic)

Build multi-component React + Tailwind + shadcn/ui apps bundled into a single HTML file.

- Source: https://github.com/anthropics/skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/skills/main/skills/web-artifacts-builder/SKILL.md
- Author: Anthropic
- License: Apache-2.0
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/web-artifacts-builder-anthropic-32211529

For bigger claude.ai artifacts that need state, routing or many components. Scripts set up a React and TypeScript project with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui pre-wired, then bundle everything into one self-contained HTML file that can be shared. It also gives style guidance to avoid generic-looking output. Needs Node.js; not meant for simple single-file artifacts.

**Try asking:**
- "Build a habit tracker artifact with tabs, charts and local state"
- "Make an interactive pricing calculator using shadcn components"
- "Turn this React prototype into a single shareable HTML file"
